content.text: Most tutorials about building a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-2|Digital Product]] store focus on the storefront. The storefront is the last thing you should configure. The backend is what makes the store work — and the backend is what most creators get wrong when they try to build without a clear sequence. In Stack 01, Google Apps Script serves as the backend Web App — it receives the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-first-principles|nowpayments]] webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction on-chain, logs the order to Google Sheets, and sends the delivery email via Gmail. In Stack 02, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-8|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Workers replaces Apps Script with a faster, more scalable serverless backend that integrates natively with Supabase for order storage and Resend for email delivery. Configure the backend first, set the webhook endpoint URL in NOWPayments second, build the storefront third, and test on mainnet fourth.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of conventional payment platforms in many regions has created a void that only infrastructure sovereignty can fill. By using Cloudflare Pages, you gain access to a scalable and reliable hosting solution that operates independently of third-party restrictions. This means you can deploy your digital store without the limitations that plague platforms like Stripe and PayPal. With crypto payment integration through NOWPayments, you ensure that your transactions are secure, fast, and efficient, allowing you to focus on what matters—selling your digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin deployment, gather the essential components for your digital store. You will need a domain name and a Cloudflare account to utilize Cloudflare Pages. Additionally, prepare your product files for upload—these could be ebooks, courses, or any digital assets you plan to sell. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as this will be your backend logic tool, essential for automating tasks. Lastly, sign up for NOWPayments to handle your crypto transactions seamlessly, ensuring a robust payment gateway.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your backend using Google Apps Script. This will manage incoming orders and integrate with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Create a script that listens for payment confirmations and triggers product delivery via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Test this pipeline on testnet to ensure that once a payment is confirmed, your product delivery is instant and smooth. This stage is crucial for maintaining customer satisfaction and trust, as delays in product delivery can lead to lost sales.
Infrastructure sovereignty ensures you own everything post-deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete, it's time to go live. Deploy your site on Cloudflare Pages and ensure all components are functioning correctly. Conduct a test transaction using the NOWPayments integration to verify the payment flow and product delivery mechanism. Once confirmed, you are ready to promote your digital store. Share your shop URL, https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, across your networks, and watch as customers begin to engage with your products. Monitor the performance and be prepared to address any initial questions or issues.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is operational, consider scaling your offerings. You can add additional products to your Cloudflare Pages site and expand your product range. Monitor customer interactions and feedback to refine your offerings. If you find that your user base is growing quickly, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities. This option includes advanced configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email management and additional support for a smoother operational experience.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free by utilizing platforms like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. By deploying your backend logic with Google Apps Script, you can automate order management and ensure seamless product delivery. This infrastructure empowers you to operate independently of traditional payment platforms.
No subscriptions or ongoing fees—pay once and own your stack.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by creating a Cloudflare account and securing your domain name. Set up Cloudflare Pages for hosting your site. Prepare your digital product files for delivery. Configure Google Apps Script for backend logic and order management. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing. Conduct test transactions to validate your payment and delivery pipeline. Launch your store and promote your unique URL.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use a combination of Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. Set up your backend logic with Google Apps Script to automate order handling and product delivery.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing deployment in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust solution deployed in 48 hours with additional features.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each option offers distinct advantages, with Cloudflare Pages providing enhanced speed and security capabilities.
How do I ensure that my product delivery is instant?

To ensure instant product delivery, integrate Google Apps Script with your payment processor. This will automate the delivery process as soon as payment confirmation is received, ensuring customers receive their products without delay.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept through NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies for transactions. This wide range allows you to cater to various customer preferences and ensures flexibility in payment options.
